title: A /help answer whose link has a space inside the parentheses still renders as a link when the address is listed
steps: S1: Run the assistant chat unit tests (packages/ui/tracy-assistant/test/chat.test.mjs) with the TAP reporter.
S2: Read the result of the test about padded parentheses and the test about the link allowlist.
expect: S2: `[Publish]( /site/?tab=tracy:site-publish&site=site)` is a link when listed; an unlisted padded address keeps only its label; wrapped and shortened addresses still resolve only through the allowlist.
evidence: Issue #1260: answers to /help showed `[Publish]( /mysite.tracy.site/?tab=tracy:site-publish&site=mysite.tracy.site)` as raw text
fence: The link allowlist: only an address the server listed becomes a link, whatever whitespace the model writes around it

tests: a model that pads the parentheses still gets its listed link; an unlisted one keeps its label
a link is clickable only when the server listed its exact address
